summary: Two incapacitated climbers stranded overnight on Kiener's Route at ~14,000 ft; rescued by a Colorado National Guard Chinook helicopter landing on the summit after wind grounded other aircraft
responding_agency: RMNP Search and Rescue + Larimer County SAR, Alpine Rescue, Rocky Mountain Rescue, CO National Guard
notes: approx; requested help Feb 6 night, flown out Feb 7; led by RMNP rangers
